name: rava-wasm-js
description: TypeScript wrapper for the Rava WASM verifier

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p rava-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rava_wasm.wasm --target nodejs --out-dir dist/wasm --out-name rava_wasm
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
